name: Corporate Gift Studio
oneLiner: A self-serve gift studio where GTA employers, realtors, brokers and clinics send J&W boxes with their logo to a whole list, or a Pick-a-Box certificate each person redeems on J&W's own delivery routes.
headline: Corporate gifting sells J&W's existing $85 to $200 boxes 20 at a time at about 40% gross margin, brings in holiday cash, and puts J&W in front of hundreds of new households each season.
focus: Holiday and year-round corporate gifts on JW routes
mechanism: J&W adds a Corporate Gift Studio with four levels built on boxes it already sells. Thank You ($90) offers the Ultimate BBQ Dad Pack ($84.99) or Girls Night Box ($89.99). Well Done ($130) offers the Gentleman's Box ($129.99), A Taste of Greece Box ($130) or Steak Mania Combo ($120). Big Thanks ($200) offers the Long Weekend Box ($199), and a new Concept J&W Reserve Box ($349) is priced from Wagyu, AAA and Ontario lamb at J&W's regular prices. A buyer adds a logo and message, uploads a list, and picks one of three deliveries: one office drop, home delivery on J&W's own route days at its usual $20/$27/$35 fees, or a Pick-a-Box certificate. With the certificate, each person picks any gift at their level, including Concept Meal Butler meal boxes, then books delivery (+$20) or free pickup at Brimley Rd. Volume pricing runs from 5% at 10 gifts to 10% at 100, approved accounts can pay by invoice (Net 30), and programs of 100+ certificates can pay only for codes that get redeemed. A year-round occasion calendar (Lunar New Year, Employee Appreciation Day, Greek Easter, realtor closings, work anniversaries), plus AI agents for quotes, list checks, messages and reminders, turns one holiday order into a year-round account.

modelledOn.name: Omaha Steaks Business Gifts
modelledOn.short: US family butcher's B2B arm: certificates, volume programs, rewards tiers
modelledOn.what: A dedicated business-gifting program from a family butcher founded in 1917. It offers curated gift boxes (US$81 to $212) and 'Choice' certificates, where each recipient picks from a curated level and redeems online, by phone or by mail. Qualifying programs get logo and message branding. Multi-recipient orders go on one order form with a single invoice. It also offers pay-on-redemption for large programs, a month-by-month holiday planning calendar, and Business Rewards tiers by annual spend.
modelledOn.proof: Company claims of 5,000+ business clients, 350,000+ custom gift certificates and 700,000+ coolers to business recipients since 2020 (Omaha Steaks internal data, 2025; verified on the live page Oct 16, 2026). The 2026 holiday business guide runs US$100 to $180. Lead-form spend buckets run from under $100 to over $250. Business Rewards tiers sit at US$5K / $20K / $50K a year.
modelledOn.jwEdge: Omaha does not ship to Canada. J&W already delivers across the GTA and Ontario on its own weekly routes for $20 to $35, with free pickup in Scarborough. It cuts in its own Ontario-inspected plant and has a Greek-Canadian family story going back to the 1960s. It can also gift clean cooked Meal Butler meals, a wellness gift Omaha cannot offer. Omaha's B2B ordering still runs on an emailed Excel form. J&W's studio is self-serve and sorts the recipient list onto route days live.

mathYear1: Lean launch Nov 9, 2026; full studio Feb 1, 2027. Five lines: (1) Holiday 2026 sprint (partial season): 25 accounts x 20 gifts x $120 = $60,000. (2) Realtor and broker closing gifts from Jan, ramping 0 -> 35 agents: avg 15 active x 10 months x 1.2 gifts x $95 = $17,100. (3) Occasion campaigns, Lunar New Year to Thanksgiving: 25 accounts x 15 gifts x $110 = $41,250. (4) Always-on milestone certificates from Mar: 8 accounts x 3 gifts/month x 8 months x $100 = $19,200. (5) Follow-on one-time orders from new-to-J&W recipients: 1,247 gifts x 60% new x 8% x $130 = $7,781. Gross = $145,331 x 0.85 incrementality = $123,532 (about $124K). Low: $74,963 x 0.75 = $56K. High: $316,941 x 0.85 = $269K.
mathRunRate: Year 2 has a full Holiday 2027 season (planning emails Sep 14, pre-booking in Oct). (1) Holiday 2027: 70 accounts (about 17 retained at 70% + 53 new) x 24 gifts x $122 = $204,960. (2) Closings: 40 agents x 12 months x 1.2 x $95 = $54,720. (3) Occasions: 40 accounts x 15 x $110 = $66,000. (4) Milestones: 15 accounts x 3 x 12 x $100 = $54,000. (5) Follow-on: 3,396 gifts x 60% x 8% x $130 = $21,191. Gross = $400,871 x 0.85 = $340,740 (about $340K a year). Gross profit at 40% is about $136K.
mathNotes: Year 1 includes only a partial first holiday season, because the lean version goes live Nov 9, 2026 and many firms choose gifts in October. Holiday 2027 lands in year 2.

Year-1 monthly shape (gross, booked): Nov $21K, Dec $39K, Jan $3K, Feb $6K, Mar $10K, Apr $12K, May $14K, Jun $9K, Jul $6K, Aug $4K, Sep $7K, Oct $14K = $145K. Nov-Dec is 41% of year 1 and about 51% of the run-rate.

The $120 average gift already nets out volume pricing (5% / 8% / 10%). The 40% margin is the model assumption for gift boxes. On a box that earns 40% at list, an 8% discount brings margin to about 35%, so big orders earn less per box.
No certificate breakage is counted. Prepaid Pick-a-Box certificates carry no expiry date, and pay-on-redemption programs bill only redeemed codes.

The follow-on line counts one-time orders only. Subscriptions are not counted here, so this does not double count Play 1, 3 or 6. Office meal programs (Play 4), wholesale (Play 2) and fundraisers (Play 7) are excluded.

Sanity check: year 1 is about 5% of J&W's ~$2.5M mid-case revenue and the run-rate is about 14%. Year 2 uses about 70 accounts. The market-benchmarks.md upside of 115 firms x 60 boxes x $120 (about $830K) would need 1% of the ~11-14K GTA locations with 50+ staff.

Capacity: Holiday 2026 is about 500 gifts over 5 weeks, peaking near 280 in the week of Dec 14. Holiday 2027 is about 1,700 gifts over 7 weeks, so it needs one seasonal packer and an extra Wednesday van in December.

Contribution after JW's own costs, before Minastech's fee: year 1 is about $49K gross profit less $29K running costs and $5.5K setup, leaving about $15K. Year 2 is about $136K less about $45K, leaving about $90K.

assumptions: A lean Holiday version is live by Mon Nov 9, 2026. It has a landing page, two-tap price, four levels and logo cards. Office drops and home delivery run as Shopify draft orders, and certificates are bulk Shopify gift-card codes with a branded email. The self-serve studio with list upload and the redemption page go live Feb 1, 2027.
Holiday 2026 is a partial season of 25 accounts x 20 gifts. Buyers come mostly from existing J&W customers who run businesses, the 30K Instagram following, and outreach along the route corridors.
The average gift is $120 after volume pricing (mix of $85 to $350 levels). That fits the $50-150 per-box estimate (market-benchmarks.md) and Omaha's $100-$250 lead buckets.
Gross margin is 40% (model-assumptions.md, premium gift boxes and corporate gifting). Logo cards, sleeves and insulated liners (about $3 a gift) are counted in JW's monthly costs.
Incrementality is 0.85, because some existing customers already buy boxes for clients.
60% of recipients are new to J&W, and 8% of those place one $130 order within the year.
No breakage revenue is counted. Prepaid certificates do not expire.
70% of Holiday 2026 accounts return for Holiday 2027.
J&W's real route fees apply ($20 GTA, $27 Halton/Hamilton, $35 long routes, $30 express). J&W waives the $100 route minimum for gift deliveries and redemptions.
Recipients must be in Ontario, because the plant is provincially inspected.
Holiday 2026 deadlines: logo-card orders by Sun Dec 6 for route delivery Dec 14-18. Plain orders by Sun Dec 13. Certificates go out by email until Dec 24.
risks: Late start for Holiday 2026: many firms pick gifts in October, so season 1 will be small. Certificates (no lead time) and existing customers are the fastest wins.

December capacity: gift volume collides with J&W's own holiday retail. Cap gifts per week (about 150 in Dec 2026) and use certificates to move redemptions into January, while watching the January Meal Butler peak.
Ontario-only sales (provincial inspection): national employers can't include out-of-province staff. The studio must screen addresses before payment.
Cold chain at office drops: boxes left in a lobby can thaw. Require a named receiver, a delivery window and a freezer or cooler, and pack in insulated liners with ice packs.
Credit risk on invoices: offer Net 30 only to approved accounts, with a 50% deposit on first orders.
Gift card and tax rules: J&W confirms certificate terms with its accountant or lawyer. Buyers own their CRA treatment, and J&W gives a gift record, not tax advice.

Product copy: the A Taste of Greece Box description contains pasted voice-dictation text and an outdated 'only until Thursday' line. Gendered names (Gentleman's, Girls Night, Dad Pack) need neutral level names for corporate buyers.
Seasonality: about half of the run-rate lands in Nov-Dec.
Reputation: corporate buyers read reviews. Put the 4.8-star Google rating (611 reviews) on the page and keep a professional Gift Desk face.
who: A named Gift Desk lead at J&W (for example Lucas or Tasia) handles quotes, proofs, buyer calls and approving AI drafts: 20 h/week in Nov-Dec and 6 h/week otherwise. Butchery and packing: +25-40 h/week in December, including one seasonal packer, and +2-3 h/week otherwise. Drivers: office drops and home deliveries ride the existing route days, plus one extra Wednesday run a week in December. Owner (Bill or Steve): about 1 h/week approving quotes over $5,000, invoice terms and the Reserve Box spec. Minastech builds the studio and agents.

costs.note: Setup: branded sleeves, insulated liners and card stock for the first 1,000 gifts ($2,400); photos of the levels and certificate design ($700); 20 tasting boxes for prospects at cost ($1,200); card and label printer ($400); 20 h of setup time ($800). Monthly average, about $29K in year 1: ads on LinkedIn, Meta and Google $730 (peaks at $1,500 in Nov-Dec and Sep-Oct, $350 otherwise); Gift Desk hours $900 (20 h/week in Nov-Dec, 6 h/week otherwise, at $25/h loaded); logo cards and sleeves at about $3 a gift ($310); extra December van runs ($200); seasonal packer ($150); software and AI ($125: bulk certificate app, invoicing, shared prospecting data, Claude API). Year 2 is about $45K/yr. Excludes Minastech's fee.

prototype.concept: A premium, self-serve corporate gifting page for J&W. A buyer gets a price in two taps, picks a level and a real J&W box, and adds a logo and message with a live card preview. They upload a recipient list that sorts itself onto J&W's real route days, flags anyone outside Ontario, and turns missing addresses into Pick-a-Box certificates. They pay by demo card through JWC.checkout or request an invoice, and can see the page each recipient uses to redeem. The JW team view shows the Gift Desk pipeline, AI-drafted quotes, list checks and messages waiting for approval, a certificate ledger, and the December cut list and route impact.
prototype.wow: The buyer taps 'Use our sample list (25 people)', and the list visibly sorts itself into route-day groups: Tue Durham 4, Wed Toronto/Mississauga 7, Wed long 1, Thu Halton/Hamilton 3, Fri York/Peel 6, Fri long 1. Calgary and Montreal are flagged in terracotta ('We can only sell meat in Ontario. Removed, you won't be charged.') and the one person with no address becomes a Pick-a-Box certificate. Meanwhile the branded card preview shows the buyer's logo and message, and the sticky bar total updates to $3,351.50.

design.inspiredBy: Omaha Steaks Business Gifts: a dark full-bleed photo hero with a left headline, one pill CTA and an 'at a glance' card; a thin promo strip; a big-number proof band; three program cards; tier cards; numbered steps; a box builder with a sticky footer (points, price, Continue); an FAQ accordion; an inline lead form; a sticky action row. Burgundy is swapped for J&W laurel navy, with Mediterranean olive and terracotta, and the American heritage story becomes the J&W family story.

palette.role: Midnight: hero overlay, dark bands, sticky studio bar
Laurel Navy (JW logo): primary buttons, links, active step, focus rings
Paper: cards, table rows, card preview
Terracotta: holiday strip, deadlines, list flags (white text 5.0:1)
Olive: 'on route' chips, Greek items, success states
Brass: Reserve level accents and laurel line art (decorative and large numerals only)
Meal Butler slate: Meal Butler box badges and options
Sky: eyebrow text and small highlights on Midnight

design.layout: Mobile-first single column at 375px with 16px gutters, scaling to a desktop max width of 1200px. The hero splits 7/5 with the 'Corporate gifts at a glance' card on the right; on mobile the card stacks under the headline. The proof band is 4 columns on desktop and 2x2 on mobile, with Fraunces numerals. Tier cards sit in a 4-across row on desktop and a horizontal snap scroller on mobile with the next card visible. The studio is a 4-step card with a progress bar and a sticky bottom bar (gifts, box, total, Continue) that only shows while the studio is in view. The redemption demo sits in a phone frame. The FAQ is an accordion. A sticky mobile action row (Call, Start, Pricing, Ask) has 44px+ targets. Section h2s are centred between hairline rules.
design.tone: Warm, plain and confident, like a family butcher who has done this for decades. Short sentences, Canadian spelling, real prices and real dates, no hype words. Quantified like Omaha, but the proof is J&W's own: since the 1960s, 1995, 2008, 4.8 stars.

sections.purpose: The self-serve builder: gift, card, people, review, ending in checkout or invoice
sections.content: H2 'Build your order'. Progress: '1 Gift / 2 Card / 3 People / 4 Review'. STEP 1 'What are you giving?': level tabs, product tiles with photo and price, a 'Send a box / Give a certificate' toggle and a quantity stepper. STEP 2 'Make it yours': fields Company name; Logo (optional, stays on your device) or 'Use a monogram'; Message (240-character counter); Signed. Button 'Write it for me', with occasion chips Holiday / Client thank-you / Milestone / Greek Easter and 3 suggestions. Holiday suggestions: 'Thank you for everything you gave this year. Enjoy a great meal at home with the people you love. Happy holidays from all of us at {Company}.' / 'A year like this deserves a proper steak night. Thank you, and happy holidays. {Signed}' / 'From our team to your table: thank you for a great 2026. {Signed}'. Client: 'Thank you for trusting us this year. Dinner's on us. {Signed}' / 'Congratulations on your new home. Here's your first dinner in it. {Signed}'. Milestone: 'Five years! Thank you for all of it. Enjoy this one on us. {Signed}'. Greek Easter: 'Kalo Pascha! Wishing you and your family a happy Easter table. {Signed}'. Live preview: card with J&W laurel mark, the buyer's logo or monogram, the message, and 'Cut and packed for you by J&W Foods, Scarborough.' The certificate preview adds code JW-MRD-130-7Q4K and 'Choose your gift at jwfoods.com/pick'. STEP 3 'Who's it for?': three options, 'One office drop' (city select from JWC.cities() + receiver name), 'Upload a list' (CSV file input + 'Use our sample list (25 people)'), 'Email certificates' (paste emails + 'Use sample (40)'). Table columns: Name / City / Route day / Fee / Status. Per-day chips. Sample list: Tue GTA 1 Pickering, Ajax, Whitby, Oshawa ($20 each); Wed GTA 2 Scarborough x2, Toronto, Mississauga, North York, Etobicoke, East York ($20); Wed long Guelph ($35); Thu GTA 3 Oakville, Hamilton, Burlington ($27); Fri GTA 4 Markham x2, Richmond Hill, Brampton, Vaughan, Newmarket ($20); Fri long Ottawa ($35); flags: Calgary AB and Montreal QC ('Outside Ontario. sections.name: Cut, packed and delivered by us
sections.purpose: Family story and food quality proof
sections.content: H2 'Cut, packed and delivered by us'. 'George Trougakos ran a butcher and grocery in downtown Toronto from the early 1960s. His family started Advance Food Products in 1973 and J&W Foods in 1995. Since 2008 we've run our own Ontario-inspected plant at 2201 Brimley Rd. Our chicken is air-chilled, grain-fed and raised in Ontario with no hormones or antibiotics. Every gift is cut, vacuum-sealed and packed here, then driven by our own team.'

sections.name: FAQ
sections.purpose: Answer the buyer's real objections honestly
sections.content: Accordion. 'Can people outside Ontario get a gift?' 'Not yet. Our plant is Ontario-inspected, so we can only sell meat within Ontario. We flag those addresses before you pay.' / 'Do certificates expire?' 'Prepaid Pick-a-Box certificates don't expire.' / 'Is a gift a taxable benefit?' 'The CRA allows up to $500 a year in non-cash gifts per employee, tax included. We'll send a gift record for your payroll team. Please check with your accountant.' / 'What if someone doesn't eat beef or pork?' 'A certificate lets them pick a Meal Butler box of chicken, salmon and egg bites. For allergies, call us first.' / 'How cold does it stay?' 'Boxes leave frozen in insulated liners with ice packs. For office drops, please have someone receive them and a freezer or cooler ready.' / 'Can we pay by invoice?' 'Yes, Net 30 for approved businesses, with a 50% deposit on a first order.' / 'Is there a minimum?' 'No. Volume pricing starts at 10 gifts.' / 'Can we pick up?' customerFlows.name: Upload a list, home delivery, card payment
steps: In the studio choose Well Done, then A Taste of Greece Box.
Step 2: type a company name and pick a message.
Step 3: choose 'Upload a list', then tap 'Use our sample list (25 people)'. Rows animate into route-day groups (Tue 4, Wed 7, Wed long 1, Thu 3, Fri 6, Fri long 1).

Step 4: review 23 gifts x $130 = $2,990, Volume pricing (5%) -$149.50, Home delivery to 22 addresses $491, Certificate delivery $20, Total $3,351.50.

Pick a city (e.g. Toronto); the real route day appears from JWC.routesFor ('Wednesday, GTA 2, delivery included'), or choose 'Pick up free at Brimley Rd'.
Leave or tick the unchecked email opt-in; tap 'Confirm my gift'.

Demo confirmation via JWC.modal: 'Booked: your Gentleman's Box arrives Wednesday on our GTA 2 route. Demo: nothing is sent.' It is logged with JWC.addOrder (total $0, note 'Pick-a-Box redemption'). Do not use JWC.checkout here, because redemptions skip the $100 minimum.

chat.name: Gift Desk
chat.greeting: Hi, I'm the J&W Gift Desk assistant. I can price a gift order, explain Pick-a-Box certificates, or check delivery days for your list. How many people are you gifting?
suggestions: When's the last day for Christmas delivery?

rules.reply: The CRA lets employers give non-cash gifts worth up to $500 a year per employee, tax included, without a taxable benefit. Every J&W level is under that: $90, $130, $200 and $350. Pick-a-Box certificates can only be used at J&W and can't be cashed out. We can send a gift record (name, date, value) for your payroll team. Please check how the rules apply to you with your accountant.

Our plant is Ontario-inspected, so we can only sell meat within Ontario. That goes for boxes and Pick-a-Box certificates. When you upload your list, we flag anyone outside Ontario before you pay, so you're never charged for a gift we can't deliver.

A J&W Pick-a-Box certificate (concept) is a code at one level: $90, $130, $200 or $350. Each person opens it, sees only the gifts at their level, and books their own route day or picks up free at Brimley Rd. Add delivery for $20 a certificate. Prepaid certificates don't expire, and programs of 100+ can pay only for the ones people redeem.

rules.match: (invoice|net ?(15|30)|purchase order|\bp\.?o\.?\b|pay later|payment terms|cheque|\beft\b|deposit|pay(ing)? by card|credit card)
rules.reply: You can pay by card at checkout for any order. Approved businesses can also pay by invoice, Net 30. For a first order we ask for a 50% deposit and the balance on delivery. Tap 'Pay by invoice' at the last step and our Gift Desk will confirm within one business day.

rules.match: (deadline|christmas|holiday|last day|by when|in time|order by|december|before the break)
rules.reply: For Holiday 2026, order by Sunday, Dec 6 for logo cards and route delivery the week of Dec 14-18. Without logo cards, order by Sunday, Dec 13. Pick-a-Box certificates go out by email right up to Dec 24, and people can redeem them in January.

Your logo and message go on a printed card in every box, or on the Pick-a-Box certificate. It's free on every order. Add your logo in step 2 and tap 'Write it for me' for a few message ideas. We send you a proof before we print anything.

We're butchers, so most gifts are meat. For mixed teams, a Pick-a-Box certificate lets people choose a Meal Butler box at the $90 or $130 level: chicken, salmon and egg bites, all salt and sugar free with no added oils, and no pork. For vegetarians, a J&W gift card works across our Greek pantry and snacks. For allergies, halal or kosher needs, please call us at (416) 298-1350 before you order.

Plenty of realtors and brokers like a closing gift that gets used. Set up your account once with your logo and message. Then each time a deal closes, send a $90 or $130 Pick-a-Box certificate from your phone, and your client books delivery on their own route day.

The J&W Reserve Box (concept, $349) is our top level. It holds 2 Wagyu striploins, 2 AAA bone-in ribeyes, 4 AAA tenderloins, a 4-pack of bacon-wrapped tenderloin, a frenched lamb rack and 8 Ontario lamb chops. That's $343 at our regular prices, packed in a keepsake box.

Volume pricing (concept): 10-49 gifts save 5%, 50-99 save 8%, 100-249 save 10%, and for 250+ we'll quote. For example, 50 Gentleman's Boxes at $129.99 less 8% come to $5,979.54 before delivery. Logo cards and your message are free. Try 'Your price in two taps' above for your own numbers.
